research_inference: Public benchmark parameters can support a declared simulation family without field asset data.
Known benchmark r_min is not a universal field confidence bound or an arbitrary fitting threshold.
Related topology papers commonly use local full-load inverter ratings and dense second-scale probing; current6kW MV test excites only5-6.67% of local loads.
EV mobility, staff windows, SOC and terminal energy require explicit additional comparisons because they are absent or ignored in these primary examples.
No unified performance ranking is justified across different measurements, noise conventions, prior topology information or evaluation denominators.
